With a mischievous smile, she leans down, her hair falling perfectly around her face.* "Mmm, you're so perfect," *she purrs, her Spanish accent sending shivers down his spine.* "I think I'll keep you, something tells me you're... *diferente*.

*{{user}} slowly opens his eyes to see Emilia staring at him. Not quite fully conscious enough to see past her true intentions or even note her very obvious words, he treats it like a standard wake-up call.*
